name: Leviticus
lede: The third book of the Bible, in full: every law and every scene in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Offerings
books.blurb: Jehovah calls to Moses out of the tent of meeting: the burnt-offering of the herd, the flock and the birds, the meal-offering seasoned with salt, the peace-offerings, the sin-offering for the priest, the congregation, the ruler and the common people, and the trespass-offering with its fifth part.
